page.layout: One title page: centred title block at top; woodcut device in the middle; imprint lines below. No margin text.

main_text.l: Inter Christianos, quamuis diuersos sententiis, religiosè procuranda, colenda, atque continenda:

page.notes: Woodcut device (a compass and a book within a wreath of fruit and foliage) with no text. Manuscript annotations in pencil or ink at the lower right and a small "Q" at upper right are handwriting and are omitted. Dark stains at the left edge are omitted. The date is printed in old form and is transcribed as MDXCIII. Printed as "cIↄ. Iↄ. XCIII." in the scan, so the reversed-C forms are normalised as required.
